title: Christmas on Commercial
seo_title: Christmas on Commercial at Cackle Hatchery, Lebanon MO
description: Christmas on Commercial is a holiday event in downtown Lebanon, Missouri, where Cackle Hatchery is one of the evening's stops and Santa Claus is scheduled to be there. Families are invited to come downtown and visit. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM at Cackle Hatchery, 411 W Commercial St.
